meta.notes: A elm sign to write on, front and back, with dye, glow ink and wax as vanilla's. It stands on the ground in sixteen directions, and placed against a side it becomes the generated wall sign msm_examples:elm_sign_wall. Its board is drawn from the planks; the writing screen shows textures/gui/signs/elm_sign.png, which the flow saves. It stacks to 16 and sounds like oak.
